verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that AI commit suggestions send staged diffs to OpenAI and are opt-in. Opt-in consent is an adjacent control, not a documented way to set retention periods or delete data sent to AI or the vendor. 'Delete Commit' is git history editing, not privacy data deletion, so nothing documents retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
